title: Data-Free Model Stealing with Semantic-Aware Queries
summary: Official code for the paper "Synthesize, Adapt, Steal: A Few-Shot Domain Adaptive Model Stealing Attack for Tabular Data," which mounts data-free model-stealing attacks against classifiers trained on ICS network traffic, Adult Income, and Diabetes tabular data. One of its two synthetic-data generation strategies trains SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) on the target's data distribution to produce the attacker's substitute training set.
